t: IBT manager on therapeutics conference, oncology breakthroughs and five years of outperformance
desc: International Biotechnology Trust Plc (LSE:IBT, OTC:IBITF) portfolio manager Marek Poszepczynski spoke with Proactive's Stephen Gunnion about emerging cancer treatments, upcoming clinical trial catalysts and the trust’s fifth consecutive year of benchmark outperformance. Speaking after a therapeutics conference in Boston, Poszepczynski highlighted developments involving Revolution Medicines, AstraZeneca, Summit Therapeutics and Moderna, with a focus on potential advances in pancreatic cancer, lung cancer and melanoma. He discussed the prospects for Revolution Medicines’ pancreatic cancer treatment, AstraZeneca’s AVANZAR trial and upcoming data from Summit Therapeutics that could challenge Merck’s blockbuster KEYTRUDA. Moderna’s melanoma results also featured, with further data expected to help clarify the treatment’s potential. Poszepczynski said IBT prioritises companies addressing significant unmet medical needs, focusing on treatments that could change clinical practice rather than deliver incremental improvements. He also explained how disciplined portfolio management has helped the trust outperform its benchmark for five consecutive years. This includes selling investments when valuations reach target levels and managing exposure to high-risk clinical trial events. Acquisition activity has also contributed to performance, with Poszepczynski saying more than a quarter of the portfolio was acquired by other companies over the previous year.
